commands.name: postpone
commands.description: Push one maintenance window's next run back, without changing its schedule

options.name: instance
options.description: The server whose window is deferred

options.name: window
options.description: The window's id — its schedule expression, e.g. weekly.sun@04:00

options.name: minutes
options.description: How far to push it back, 1 to 720. Defaults to 60.

commands.name: skip
commands.description: Drop one maintenance window's next run; the one after it is unaffected

options.name: instance
options.description: The server whose window is skipped

options.name: window
options.description: The window's id — its schedule expression, e.g. weekly.sun@04:00

commands.name: run-now
commands.description: Run one maintenance window at the next poll, without changing its schedule

options.name: window
options.description: The window's id — its schedule expression, e.g. weekly.sun@04:00
